_comment: Tick-mode counterpart of emulator_smoke.fixture.json. tick_mode: true tells the runner to allocate a tick socket, pass --tick-socket to the bridge, and export KLIPPY_TICK_SOCKET so the reactor connects on startup; the bridge then only advances simavr in response to klippy's `advance T` lines. Implies sim_time. Same SHT3X i2c reads as the parallel-mode smoke test so the sensor decode path is exercised under deterministic timing.
